network.ike.knowledge.spi.ChangeSetRequest

  • Uses of ChangeSetRequest in network.ike.knowledge.spi

    Subinterfaces with type arguments of type ChangeSetRequest in network.ike.knowledge.spi
    Modifier and Type
    Interface
    Description
    interface 
    ChangeSetCompactor
    A change set tool that writes a format-1 or format-2 change set in format 3: a component table, one entry per pattern, references by sequence (ike:changeset-compact).
    interface 
    ChangeSetExpander
    A change set tool that writes a format-3 change set again in the format-2 layout, every reference by UUID, for a reader that knows no sequences (ike:changeset-expand).
    interface 
    ChangeSetInspector
    A change set tool that reports what a change set is made of, without a store: its format version, its entries, its records by kind and pattern, its component table, and how its references are written (ike:changeset-inspect).
    interface 
    ChangeSetVerifier
    A change set tool that checks a change set against its format and reports every error and warning; ChangeSetReport.ok() is false on any error (ike:changeset-verify).
